description: This source file defines functions for managing a vector of objects to delete, including initialization, destruction, adding objects, checking paths, and failure analysis. It is part of a data model management system related to deleting groups of objects.

methods.name: void GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_Init(group_del_vector_t * gdv)
methods.description: Initializes a group_del_vector_t structure by setting its vector to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: void GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_Destroy(group_del_vector_t * gdv)
methods.description: Frees all dynamically allocated memory within the vector, including individual entry strings, and resets entry count.

methods.name: void GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_AddObjectsToDelete(group_del_vector_t * gdv,str_vector_t * obj_paths,int_vector_t * group_ids)
methods.description: Adds multiple object paths and associated group IDs to the vector, moving the path strings from the input vector.

methods.name: void GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_AddObjectNotDeleted(group_del_vector_t * gdv,char * obj_path,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Adds a single unresolved or failed object path with error information to the vector.

methods.name: bool GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_AreAllPathsTheSameGroupId(group_del_vector_t * gdv,int * single_group_id)
methods.description: Checks whether all paths in the vector are associated with the same data model provider component, identified by group_id.

methods.name: group_del_entry_t * GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_FindFirstFailureIfAllFailed(group_del_vector_t * gdv,int index,int num_objects)
methods.description: Checks if all specified objects in a slice of the vector failed to delete; if so, returns the first failure.
